content.description: Hiring a concrete contractor is a long-term investment in your property. Maxima Concrete carries the full credentials and coverage that protect your home, your wallet, and your peace of mind.

content.title: Every layer of protection a homeowner should expect
content.description: Four credentials. Zero exposure. Each one independently verifiable before we break ground.
content.cardDescription: Every job. Every crew. Every pour. We supply current Certificates of Insurance on request — no exceptions.

items.title: Fully Licensed
items.text: Registered and licensed to operate as a concrete contractor across the State of Ohio, in full compliance with local municipal requirements.

items.title: General Liability Insured
items.text: Comprehensive general liability coverage protects your property throughout every phase of your project.

items.title: Workers' Compensation
items.text: Every crew member is covered by workers' comp, so homeowners are never exposed to liability for on-site injuries.

items.title: OSHA-Aligned Safety
items.text: Our teams follow OSHA-aligned safety protocols on every residential and commercial job site.

content.description: Anyone can print a logo. We carry verifiable Ohio licensing, active liability and workers' comp policies, and we pull the permits the city requires — on every single job.
Three concrete ways our credentials translate into outcomes that show up the day a shovel hits dirt — and the day a claim could've blown up your week.

items.title: Your Property is Protected
items.text: Liability coverage means accidental damage is covered — not paid out of your pocket.

items.title: No Legal Exposure for You
items.text: If a crew member is injured on your property, workers' comp covers it. You're never named.

items.title: Code-Compliant Work
items.text: Licensed status means every pour is permitted and built to code where required.

content.description: Don't see your question? We're happy to walk you through anything — including emailing you a current COI before you sign.

items.question: Can I see proof of insurance before signing?
items.answer: Absolutely. We provide current Certificates of Insurance (COI) on request before any project begins.

items.question: Are you bonded?
items.answer: Bonding is available for qualifying projects, particularly commercial and municipal contracts. Ask your project manager for details.

items.question: Why does hiring a licensed contractor matter?
items.answer: Unlicensed contractors leave you exposed to code violations, fines, and liability for any injury on your property. Licensed work also protects resale value.

items.question: Do you pull permits when required?
items.answer: Yes. When a municipality requires a permit for the scope of work, we handle the application as part of our service.
